content.text: {"id": "mm5239a1", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Counts of cardiac deaths ranged from 72 to 149 deaths per day during the study period"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "DOHMH estimated the relative risk for cardiac deaths in the period after vaccination compared with other periods"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "count/rate", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Counts of cardiac deaths were modeled by using Poisson regression analysis"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Of the 81,010 legible records available, 39,150 (48%) listed cardiac disease"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Daily mortality rates during the postvaccination risk periods were compared with rates during other periods."}]}, {"v": "stratified/adjusted", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "compared with other periods among persons aged 50--64 years"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "ecologic", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "This was an ecologic study; data about individual vaccination status for the 1947 population were unavailable."}]}, {"v": "before/after or trend", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "DOHMH estimated the relative risk for cardiac deaths in the period after vaccination compared with other periods"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Counts of cardiac deaths were modeled by using Poisson regression analysis, adjusting for a long-term temporal trend during 1946--1948"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "DOHMH estimated the relative risk for cardiac deaths in the period after vaccination compared with other periods, adjusting for secular trends."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Certificates with illegible primary cause-of-death codes (0.6% of records) were excluded."}, {"loc": "ocr", "q": "All models are adjusted for long-term temporal and seasonal trends."}], "confidence": "high", "uncertain_fields": ["study_design"]}
